title: [main] Bug 657914 Total Number of Supplies has incorrect type and tooltip in the VAT Report page of the German version.
summary: The Total Number of Supplies field in the VAT Report page is corrected to display as a whole number instead of an amount with decimal places in the German version.
key_points: Field 33 in VATReportHeader is a Decimal FlowField that was incorrectly formatted as an amount with two decimal places
Changed AutoFormatType and DecimalPlaces settings to display the field as a whole number, matching the source field behavior
Avoids a breaking schema change by keeping the field as Decimal type while correcting its display format
Fixes incorrect tooltip and type presentation in the German VAT Report page
quote: Total Number of Supplies has incorrect type and tooltip in the VAT Report page of the German version.
